#
LAYER
  NAME "bplanrastertindex"
  EXTENT 250063.8076 5227492.3957 961955.3570 6122928.5640
  STATUS OFF
  CONNECTION ""
  CONNECTIONTYPE POSTGIS
  PROCESSING "CLOSE_CONNECTION=DEFER"
  VALIDATION
    "planId" "^[0-9]*$"
    "default_planId" ""
    "xpversion" "^.*$"
    "default_xpversion" ""
    "planName" "^.*$"
    "default_planName" ""
    "ags" "^.*$"
    "default_ags" ""
    "internalId" "^.*$"
    "default_internalId" ""
    "rechtsstand" "^.*$"
    "default_rechtsstand" ""
  END
  DATA "geom FROM (SELECT row_number() OVER () as ogc_fid, id || '_' || filename as location, srs, ST_Transform(wkb_geometry,25832) as geom FROM
                  (SELECT
                  p.id as id,
                  a.filename as filename,
                  a.srs as srs,
                  p.bbox as wkb_geometry
                  FROM xplanmgr.artefacts a
                  LEFT JOIN xplanmgr.plans p
                       ON a.plan = p.id
                  WHERE a.artefacttype='RASTERBASIS'
                        AND p.planstatus = $1
                        AND xp_type = $2
                        AND (coalesce($3, '') = '' OR p.id = $3::integer)
                        AND (coalesce($4, '') = '' OR p.xp_version LIKE '%' || replace($4,'.',''))
                        AND (coalesce($5, '') = '' OR p.name LIKE $5)
=== raster layer DATA ===
     "init=EPSG:25832"
  META
  END
  TYPE RASTER
END # LAYER

#
# BPlan In Aufstellung
#
LAYER
  NAME "bplanrasterpretindex"
  EXTENT 250063.8076 5227492.3957 961955.3570 6122928.5640
  STATUS OFF
  CONNECTION ""
  CONNECTIONTYPE POSTGIS
  PROCESSING "CLOSE_CONNECTION=DEFER"
  VALIDATION
    "planId" "^[0-9]*$"
    "default_planId" ""
    "xpversion" "^.*$"
    "default_xpversion" ""
    "planName" "^.*$"
    "default_planName" ""
    "ags" "^.*$"
    "default_ags" ""
    "internalId" "^.*$"
    "default_internalId" ""
    "rechtsstand" "^.*$"
    "default_rechtsstand" ""
  END
  DATA "geom FROM (SELECT row_number() OVER () as ogc_fid, id || '_' || filename as location, srs, ST_Transform(wkb_geometry,25832) as geom FROM
                  (SELECT
                  p.id as id,
                  a.filename as filename,
                  a.srs as srs,
                  p.bbox as wkb_geometry
                  FROM xplanmgr.artefacts a
                  LEFT JOIN xplanmgr.plans p
                       ON a.plan = p.id
                  WHERE a.artefacttype='RASTERBASIS'
                        AND p.planstatus = $1
                        AND xp_type = $2
                        AND (coalesce($3, '') = '' OR p.id = $3::integer)
                        AND (coalesce($4, '') = '' OR p.xp_version LIKE '%' || replace($4,'.',''))
                        AND (coalesce($5, '') = '' OR p.name LIKE $5)
                        AND (coalesce($6, '') = '' OR (select array_to_string(array_agg(ags),'|') from xplanmgr.gemeinden WHERE plan = p.id) LIKE $6)
